label: caiso 16 ixshape-full (PROBE)
definition: (PROBE — REJECTED, regression.) Keeper + full --interchange-shaping (cap import availability by the measured EIA-930 month x hour net-interchange envelope). Tests the confirmed root cause: the static import node imports a flat ~4 GW every hour, but real CAISO net imports follow a strong diurnal shape (5.2-5.6 GW overnight vs 1.0-1.6 GW midday). RESULT: mean 42.0 -> 51.3, p50 46.8 -> 53.8, neg 407 -> 88 (recall 12%) — a hard regression. The availability cap is a fraction of TOTAL tranche capacity (11.4 GW), so even overnight (where the envelope is high) the cheap baseload imports are starved and gas substitutes in EVERY hour (+15 across the board). The export-only variant was a byte-identical no-op (model is short midday, no surplus to export). Conclusion: an availability cap is the wrong instrument; the diurnal miss needs a measured diurnal import PRICE shape, not a capacity cap.
